instruction: 本周会议排期有冲突。按 `/tmp/schedule/rule.txt`，对同名会议以 Android Simple Calendar Pro 为准同步日期、开始/结束时间和地点，非同名会议保持不变，并在 Linux `/tmp/schedule/log.json` 记录每个变更字段的旧值和新值。
surfaces: Android Simple Calendar Pro + Linux schedule -> Linux corrected CSV + log
evaluator_assumptions: week.csv must be corrected from Android Calendar while unrelated meetings stay unchanged, and log.json must record every changed Vendor planning field with old and new values
